description.text: An enhancement pack of the LEGEND series, sold for a limited time from 16 April 2010, with seven cards a pack, one of them holo, and no mirror cards. Its 40 cards are built around the Lost Zone, a space from which cards can never return for the rest of the game. They include Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND, the Great Pokémon Absol and Mew, whose Poké-Body Lost Link lets it use the attacks of Pokémon in either player's Lost Zone, and the Stadium Lost World, which gives a new way to win. Most of its cards reached English players in HS—Triumphant in November 2010, and the rest, Lost World among them, in Call of Legends.
